clippings.speaker: Robert De Niro
clippings.quote: I just said, 'That kid had something special,' and then they turned around and wound up using Leo…
clippings.title: Robert De Niro Says He Knew Leonardo DiCaprio Had 'Something Special' When They Met 30 Years Ago (Exclusive)
clippings.context: Recalling the 1993 audition: he told producer Art Linson about DiCaprio after meeting him for This Boy's Life.

notes: De Niro-to-DiCaprio is thin: only one fetched exchange (People, Feb 2024); Rolling Stone, Deadline Q&A and Variety pages were paywalled or redirected to blocked tollbit hosts (402). Several famous lines (Variety 'never got over', 'I was the one who said you should get the job') were only seen in aggregators, so skipped.
